transcript.text: Thanks everyone for being here. As we work through finalizing the operating charter for the merged customer-success teams, I want to make sure we follow the standard process. Before I approve and sign the charter, I need each team representative and People Operations to state any relevant commitments, constraints, or process requirements you have that should be reflected in the charter. This is our chance to surface anything that needs to be accounted for — whether it's existing commitments to customers, team-specific processes, HR requirements, or anything else. Who would like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Before the merger, both teams signed a temporary agreement that decisions affecting customer-facing commitments require unanimous consent for the first 60 days after the merger. I retained the signed copy, but it was not attached to the draft charter. This is a relevant commitment that should be reflected in the charter before it's signed.

transcript.text: I have an approved work arrangement that prevents me from reliably attending meetings before 10:00 and requires agenda materials at least 48 hours in advance so I can participate fully.
